1	"""Human-readable invoice rendering."""
     2	
     3	WIDTH = 46
     4	
     5	
     6	def _rule(char="-"):
     7	    return char * WIDTH
     8	
     9	
    10	def format_line(item):
    11	    left = "{0} x{1}".format(item.description, item.quantity)
    12	    right = "{0:.2f}".format(item.line_total())
    13	    pad = WIDTH - len(left) - len(right)
    14	    if pad < 1:
    15	        pad = 1
    16	    return left + (" " * pad) + right
    17	
    18	
    19	def format_report(invoice):
    20	    lines = []
    21	    lines.append(_rule("="))
    22	    lines.append("Invoice {0}".format(invoice.number))
    23	    lines.append("Customer: {0}".format(invoice.customer))
    24	    lines.append(_rule())
    25	    for item in invoice.items:
    26	        lines.append(format_line(item))
    27	    lines.append(_rule())
    28	    lines.append("Subtotal: {0:.2f}".format(invoice.subtotal()))
    29	    lines.append("Tax: {0:.2f}".format(invoice.tax()))
    30	    lines.append("Total: {0:.2f}".format(invoice.total()))
    31	    return "\n".join(lines)
